content.comment_body: I purchased a starter kit along with my [product_name] and received DVDs containing [product_name] and [product_name] software. After installation, I couldn't locate the [product_name] in the device menus. I searched online and noticed others asked about this before, but those threads are now outdated. Is there any recent information about this? Can the [product_name] work with the [product_name] software? Or why did [company_name] include this software bundle with my [product_name] if it isn't actually useful for me?

The [product_name] basic software isn’t intended for the [product_name]; it’s designed for [company_name] Basic Panels. Why does [company_name] include this particular software in the starter kit? It seems [company_name] expects you to eventually buy a Basic Panel. Programming the [product_name] is only possible using [product_name], not with [product_name].

Okay, thanks for clarifying. I guess I can just uninstall it then, although the installation and updates took me a few hours. On a positive note, it looks like I can use Ignition Makers Edition with my [product_name], which seems quite interesting.

analysis.insight_summary: Users felt confused and frustrated after receiving [product_name] and [product_name] software with their [product_name] starter kit, expecting these applications to be compatible with the device. Since support for [product_name] in [product_name] software was missing, users felt installation time was wasted and viewed the provided software bundle as irrelevant, fostering disappointment with product packaging and guidance.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward compatibility between [product_name], [product_name] software, and the [product_name] device, along with clear instructions regarding the appropriate software required for programming their [product_name]. They want the bundled software to directly support the advertised functions of their product.
